cases.name: set-config-over-comment-and-jwt
cases.description: Transaction-local set_config takes precedence over both trailing comment and JWT claims.

input.sql: UPDATE invoice SET status='paid' WHERE id=1 /*auditstream='eyJ0eXBlIjoiYXBpX2tleSIsImlkIjoia2V5XzkifQ'*/;

cases.name: comment-over-jwt
cases.description: Trailing comment takes precedence over JWT claims when set_config is unset.

input.sql: UPDATE invoice SET status='paid' WHERE id=1 /*auditstream='eyJ0eXBlIjoidXNlciIsImlkIjoidXNyXzQyIn0'*/;

cases.name: jwt-alone
cases.description: JWT sub claim produces a user actor when neither set_config nor comment is present.

input.sql: UPDATE invoice SET total=55 WHERE id=2;

cases.name: no-actor
cases.description: When set_config, comment, and JWT are all absent, actor and actor_source are null.

input.sql: UPDATE invoice SET total=55 WHERE id=2;

cases.name: empty-setting-after-commit-falls-through-to-comment
cases.description: Empty string in auditstream.actor (PostgreSQL's post-commit state) is treated as unset and falls through to comment.

input.sql: UPDATE invoice SET status='paid' WHERE id=1 /*auditstream='eyJ0eXBlIjoidXNlciIsImlkIjoidXNyXzQyIn0'*/;

cases.name: empty-setting-after-commit-alone
cases.description: Empty string in auditstream.actor with no comment or JWT resolves to null.

input.sql: UPDATE invoice SET status='paid' WHERE id=1;

cases.name: malformed-set-config-does-not-fall-through
cases.description: Malformed auditstream.actor MUST yield invalid and MUST NOT fall through to a valid comment.

input.sql: UPDATE invoice SET status='paid' WHERE id=1 /*auditstream='eyJ0eXBlIjoidXNlciIsImlkIjoidXNyXzQyIn0'*/;

cases.name: malformed-comment-does-not-fall-through
cases.description: Malformed auditstream comment MUST yield invalid and MUST NOT fall through to valid JWT claims.

input.sql: UPDATE invoice SET status='paid' WHERE id=1 /*auditstream='!!!notbase64'*/;

cases.name: malformed-set-config-unknown-type-does-not-fall-through
cases.description: set_config with actor.type outside the 5 spec enum values yields invalid and MUST NOT fall through.

input.sql: UPDATE invoice SET status='paid' WHERE id=1 /*auditstream='eyJ0eXBlIjoidXNlciIsImlkIjoidXNyXzQyIn0'*/;

cases.name: malformed-set-config-non-object-context-does-not-fall-through
cases.description: set_config with non-object context yields invalid and MUST NOT fall through.

input.sql: UPDATE invoice SET status='paid' WHERE id=1 /*auditstream='eyJ0eXBlIjoidXNlciIsImlkIjoidXNyXzQyIn0'*/;

cases.name: jwt-non-object-claims-invalid
cases.description: Non-object JSON in request.jwt.claims yields actor_source='invalid'.

input.sql: UPDATE invoice SET total=55 WHERE id=2;

cases.name: jwt-object-without-sub-is-null
cases.description: Valid JSON object in request.jwt.claims without sub (for example anonymous PostgREST role) yields null.

input.sql: UPDATE invoice SET total=55 WHERE id=2;

cases.name: jwt-empty-sub-invalid
cases.description: Empty string sub claim in request.jwt.claims yields actor_source='invalid'.

input.sql: UPDATE invoice SET total=55 WHERE id=2;
